title: Velvety Dutch Noodle Noodles
description: A peppery and gooey Dutch dish featuring oyster sauce with an al-dente finish, perfect for a romantic evening, and is macrobiotic-friendly.

ingredients.name: whole wheat noodles
ingredients.notes: preferably made from durum wheat semolina

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the noodles according to the package instructions until they are al-dente.
In a small bowl, whisk together the oyster sauce and sesame oil.
In a large skillet, heat the oyster sauce mixture over medium heat.
Add the pepper and sea salt to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and toss to coat with the sauce.
Add the sliced scallions and cooked mung beans to the skillet and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the mixture for 2 minutes.
Stir in the shredded dutch cheese until it is melted and the sauce is smooth.
Serve the noodles hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
